title: Dividend tax reforms: Why design shapes revenue and measured inequality

title_primary: 股息税改革：为何设计影响财政收入与测度不平等
title_secondary: Dividend tax reforms: Why design shapes revenue and measured inequality
authors: Yonatan Berman, Esteban Klor
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Governments increasingly look to capital income for both revenue and redistribution. This column compares two dividend tax reforms in Israel – a permanent rate increase and a temporary one-year cut – to examine how high-income taxpayers can adjust the timing and labelling of dividends in ways that undermine reform. Both produced immediate surges of more than 100% in reported dividends and tax revenue. But only the temporary reform left a lasting mark: payouts fell sharply once the relief expired, as firms retained earnings in anticipation of future cuts. Because undistributed profits are not recorded as personal income, the resulting rise in retained earnings also made top-income inequality appear to fall.
abstract_zh: 各国政府日益依赖资本收入来增加财政收入和实现再分配。本文比较了以色列两项股息税改革——一项是永久性税率上调，另一项是临时性一年期减税——以考察高收入纳税人如何通过调整股息申报时间和分类来削弱改革效果。两项改革均导致申报股息和税收收入立即激增超过100%。但只有临时性改革留下了持久影响：当税收优惠到期后，股息支付大幅下降，因为企业为预期中的未来减税而留存收益。由于未分配利润不计入个人收入，由此产生的留存收益增加也使得顶层收入不平等程度看似有所下降。

authors: Bin Li, Yifan Xu, Shumaila Shahab, Yasir Shahab
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines whether climate risk is associated with excess executive perquisites (perks) among Chinese listed firms over the period 2014–2022. Using a city-level climate risk index based on disaster-related fatalities and economic losses, we find that firms exposed to greater climate risk tend to exhibit higher excess executive perks. This positive association is weaker for firms with greater media coverage and stronger digital technology application. The results remain robust to a range of additional analyses, including alternative climate-risk and perk measures, propensity score matching, first-difference specifications, confounder tests, and Fama – MacBeth regressions. Overall, the paper contributes to the literature on the governance consequences of climate risk by showing that climate-related pressure is associated with greater implicit executive consumption and that stronger external scrutiny and governance-related discipline may mitigate this relation.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了2014-2022年间中国上市公司面临的气候风险是否与超额高管在职消费（perks）存在关联。基于城市层面以灾害相关死亡人数和经济损失构建的气候风险指数，我们发现：面临较高气候风险的企业往往表现出更高的超额高管在职消费水平。媒体关注度较高及数字技术应用较强的企业，这种正向关联会有所减弱。在包括替代性气候风险与在职消费指标、倾向得分匹配、一阶差分模型、混淆变量检验以及Fama-MacBeth回归在内的一系列附加分析中，该结果依然保持稳健。总体而言，本文通过揭示气候相关压力与更高隐性高管消费之间的关联，并论证更强外部监督与治理约束可能缓解这一关系，为气候风险治理后果的相关文献做出了贡献。关键词：气候风险；超额高管在职消费；公司治理；数字技术应用；中国JEL分类：Q54 G34 J33 O33 Q58致谢：我们感谢编辑及三位匿名审稿人在审稿过程中提出的建设性意见。

title: Ideology and the scope of judicial discretion: evidence from the federal district courts
title_zh: 意识形态与司法裁量范围：来自联邦地区法院的证据
title_primary: 意识形态与司法裁量范围：来自联邦地区法院的证据
title_secondary: Ideology and the scope of judicial discretion: evidence from the federal district courts
authors: Banks Miller, Brett Curry
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines how changes in judicial discretion influence ideological decision-making in the federal courts. Leveraging a pair of unanimous Supreme Court decisions that expanded district judges’ discretion to award attorney’s fees in patent litigation, we investigate whether this procedural reform led to substantive shifts in outcomes. Our differences-in-differences design reveals that conservative judges became significantly more likely to award fees after 2014 while more liberal ones did not. We observe no similar pattern in copyright cases, which experienced no comparable expansion of discretion. This patent-specific effect is driven by accused infringers seeking fees after defeating patent claims, consistent with conservative preferences for deterring frivolous litigation. Even unanimous, procedurally focused appellate rulings can lead to asymmetric ideological effects. These findings have implications for understanding how changes in discretionary authority—including the Court’s recent abandonment of Chevron deference—may systematically empower certain ideological preferences in the federal judiciary.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨司法裁量权的变化如何影响联邦法院的意识形态决策。借助两起一致通过的最高法院判决（这些判决扩大了地区法官在专利诉讼中裁定律师费的裁量权），我们考察了这一程序性改革是否导致了判决结果的实质性转变。采用双重差分法分析发现，2014年后保守派法官裁定律师费的可能性显著增加，而自由派法官则未呈现类似趋势。在版权案件中（其裁量权未经历同等扩张），我们未观察到相似模式。这种专利特有的效应主要由败诉方在专利主张被驳回后寻求律师费补偿所驱动，这与保守派偏好遏制滥诉行为的立场一致。即使是全体一致通过、聚焦程序问题的上诉裁决，也可能引发非对称的意识形态效应。这些发现对于理解裁量权变化——包括最高法院近期放弃雪佛龙尊重原则——如何系统性地强化联邦司法体系中特定意识形态偏好具有启示意义。

title: The systemic impact of edges in financial networks
title_zh: 金融网络中边缘的系统性影响
title_primary: 金融网络中边缘的系统性影响
title_secondary: The systemic impact of edges in financial networks
authors: Michel Alexandre, Thiago Christiano Silva, Francisco A. Rodrigues
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we assess how the stability of financial networks is affected by interconnectedness considering its tiniest variation: the edge. We compute the impact of edges as the percentage difference in the systemic risk (SR) of the whole network caused by the inclusion of that edge. We apply this framework to a thorough Brazilian dataset to compute the impact of bank-firm edges. After observing that (i) edges are heterogeneous regarding their impact on the SR, and (ii) the fraction of edges whose impact on the SR is non-positive increases with the level of the initial shock, we use machine learning techniques to try to predict two variables: the criticality of the edges (defining as critical an edge whose impact on SR is significantly greater than that of the others) and the sign of the edge impact. The level of accuracy obtained in these prediction exercises was very high. These results have important implications for the development macroprudential policies aimed at financial stability. Our framework allows to identify, based on features related to the origin and destination nodes of the edge (i.e., the lending bank and the borrowing firm), whether an additional loan will have a significant and positive impact on the SR.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了金融网络稳定性如何受互联性影响，重点关注其最细微的变化：边。我们通过计算某条边加入后对整个网络系统性风险（SR）造成的百分比差异，来衡量该边的影响。我们将这一框架应用于详尽的巴西数据集，以计算银行-企业边的影响。在观察到以下两点后：（i）各边对系统性风险的影响具有异质性；（ii）对系统性风险影响为非正值的边所占比例随初始冲击水平上升而增加，我们运用机器学习技术尝试预测两个变量：边的关键性（将系统性风险影响显著高于其他边的边定义为关键边）以及边影响的符号。这些预测练习的准确度非常高。上述结果对旨在维护金融稳定的宏观审慎政策制定具有重要启示。我们的框架能够基于边起点与终点节点（即贷款银行与借款企业）的相关特征，识别新增贷款是否会对系统性风险产生显著正向影响。

title: Risk Design: AI and Prediction Beyond Screening in Insurance Markets
title_zh: 风险设计：保险市场中超越筛选的人工智能与预测
title_primary: 风险设计：保险市场中超越筛选的人工智能与预测
title_secondary: Risk Design: AI and Prediction Beyond Screening in Insurance Markets
authors: Alex Chan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: I study insurance markets in which scalable prediction, like AI, designs residual risk rather than merely classifies fixed risk. A complete-contracting benchmark shows that if prevention is observable, contractible, competitively supplied, and fully priced, it does not matter whether consumers, insurers, or vendors supply it. Adverse selection breaks such irrelevance. When high-risk consumers are more "AI-treatable," efficient prevention makes low-risk contracts attractive to them. A contract intended for low-risk consumers faces a risk-design trilemma: separate, prevent efficiently, or avoid cross-subsidy, but not all three. The result extends Rothschild-Stiglitz from distorted coverage to distorted risk-control technology and offers market design insights of AI in insurance markets.
abstract_zh: 本文研究保险市场中可扩展预测（如人工智能）如何设计残余风险，而非仅仅对固定风险进行分类。一个完全契约基准表明，若预防行为可观测、可契约化、由竞争性市场提供且完全定价，则无论由消费者、保险公司还是供应商提供预防，其结果均无差异。逆向选择打破了这种无关性。当高风险消费者更具“人工智能可治疗性”时，有效预防会使低风险契约对其产生吸引力。针对低风险消费者的契约面临风险设计的三难困境：分离、有效预防或避免交叉补贴，但三者不可兼得。该结论将罗斯柴尔德-斯蒂格利茨模型从扭曲的保险覆盖范围扩展至扭曲的风险控制技术，并为人工智能在保险市场中的市场设计提供了洞见。

official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes trade patterns across the Caribbean Community (CARICOM)—15 Caribbean countries—and makes three main contributions. First, it provides a unified empirical assessment of Caribbean external connectivity by jointly analyzing goods trade, tourism flows, and cross-border banking linkages within a consistent gravity-model framework. Second, it presents new evidence on the role of physical connectivity—shipping and air transport—in shaping both import source concentration and tourism inflows, drawing on granular bilateral trade, tourism, and flight capacity data. Third, it shows that, while financial connectivity matters in a global context, it is not the primary binding constraint for Caribbean economies; instead, limited physical connectivity emerges as the more decisive factor shaping trade patterns and external vulnerabilities.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了加勒比共同体（CARICOM）——15个加勒比国家——的贸易模式，并作出三项主要贡献。首先，通过在一个一致的引力模型框架内联合分析商品贸易、旅游流和跨境银行联系，对加勒比地区的外部连通性进行了统一的实证评估。其次，利用细粒度的双边贸易、旅游和航班运力数据，揭示了物理连通性（航运和航空运输）在塑造进口来源集中度和旅游流入方面的作用。第三，研究表明，尽管金融连通性在全球背景下具有重要意义，但它并非加勒比经济体的主要约束因素；相反，有限的物理连通性成为塑造贸易模式和外部脆弱性的更具决定性的因素。

abstract: This paper presents an economic analysis of US agricultural policy, building on a modified version of Gardner's efficient redistribution. We argue that agricultural policy is motivated as an attempt to implement an efficient redistribution scheme that redistributes income toward farmers who, as a group, have been adversely affected by agricultural productivity growth. We show how this approach helps explain why subsidies are more common in agriculture than in other sectors of the economy. We explore how our analysis provides new and useful insights into the design and implementation of US agricultural policy.
abstract_zh: 本文基于加德纳有效再分配理论的修正版本，对美国农业政策进行了经济分析。我们认为，农业政策的动机在于试图实施一种有效的再分配方案，将收入重新分配给那些因农业生产率增长而受到不利影响的农民群体。我们展示了这一方法如何有助于解释为何补贴在农业领域比在经济其他部门更为普遍。我们探讨了我们的分析如何为美国农业政策的设计与实施提供新颖且有益的见解。

title: The Shapley value and the strength of weak players in big boss games
title_zh: 大老板博弈中的沙普利值与弱参与者力量
title_primary: 大老板博弈中的沙普利值与弱参与者力量
title_secondary: The Shapley value and the strength of weak players in big boss games
authors: Luis A. Guardiola, Ana Meca
official: 官方在线 2026-04-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Big Boss Games represent a specific class of cooperative games where a single veto player, known as the Big Boss, plays a central role in determining resource allocation and maintaining coalition stability. In this paper, we introduce a novel allocation scheme for Big Boss games, based on two classical solution concepts: the Shapley value and the \(\tau \)-value. This scheme generates a coalitionally stable allocation that effectively accounts for the contributions of weaker players. Specifically, we consider a diagonal of the core that includes the Big Boss’s maximum aspirations, the \(\tau \)-value, and those of the weaker players. From these allocations, we select the one that is closest to the Shapley value, referred to as the Projected Shapley Value allocation (PSV allocation). Through our analysis, we identify a new property of Big Boss games, particularly the relationship between the allocation discrepancies assigned by the \(\tau \)-value and the Shapley value, with a particular focus on the Big Boss and the other players. Additionally, we provide a new characterization of convexity within this context. Finally, we conduct a statistical analysis to assess the position of the PSV allocation within the core, especially in cases where computing the Shapley value is computationally challenging. abstract_zh: 大老板博弈是一类特殊的合作博弈，其中被称为"大老板"的单一否决权玩家在决定资源分配和维护联盟稳定性方面发挥着核心作用。本文基于两个经典解概念——沙普利值和τ值——为大老板博弈提出了一种新的分配方案。该方案能够产生联盟稳定的分配结果，有效体现弱势玩家的贡献。具体而言，我们考虑核心的对角线，该对角线包含大老板的最大期望值、τ值以及弱势玩家的期望值。从这些分配方案中，我们选取最接近沙普利值的分配方案，称为投影沙普利值分配（PSV分配）。通过分析，我们发现了大老板博弈的一个新性质，特别是τ值与沙普利值所分配的差异之间的关系，重点关注大老板与其他玩家之间的差异。此外，我们还在该背景下给出了凸性的新刻画。最后，我们通过统计分析评估PSV分配在核心中的位置，特别是在计算沙普利值存在计算困难的情况下。

title: The toll of tariffs: The impact of protectionism on education and fertility in late 19th century France
title_zh: 关税的代价：19世纪末法国保护主义对教育与生育率的影响
title_primary: 关税的代价：19世纪末法国保护主义对教育与生育率的影响
title_secondary: The toll of tariffs: The impact of protectionism on education and fertility in late 19th century France
authors: Vincent Bignon, Cecilia García-Peñalosa
official: 官方在线 2025-05-30 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper asks whether macroeconomic policy can affect fertility and education by documenting a slow-down of long-term improvements in these two outcomes in the wake of a major protectionist shock that shielded low-skilled individuals from the adverse consequences of the first wave of globalisation. We build a novel dataset for 19th-century France where, following decades of rising grain imports at low prices, high tariffs on cereal were introduced in 1892, shifting relative prices in favour of agriculture and away from industry. We exploit regional data that allow us to measure differences in the intensity of the protectionist shock and find that the tariff halted the long-term increase in schooling and slowed-down the decline in fertility that were already well underway.
abstract_zh: 本文通过记录一次重大保护主义冲击后生育率与教育水平长期改善进程的放缓，探讨宏观经济政策能否影响这两项指标。该保护主义政策使低技能劳动者免受第一波全球化浪潮的不利影响。我们构建了19世纪法国的新数据集：在经历数十年低价谷物进口增长后，1892年对谷物征收高额关税，导致相对价格向农业倾斜而偏离工业。通过利用可衡量保护主义冲击强度的区域数据，我们发现该关税政策终止了已持续多年的教育普及化进程，并减缓了生育率的下降趋势。

title: Investing in Friends: The Role of Geopolitical Alignment in FDI Flows
title_zh: 投资于朋友：地缘政治联盟在外国直接投资流动中的作用
title_primary: 投资于朋友：地缘政治联盟在外国直接投资流动中的作用
title_secondary: Investing in Friends: The Role of Geopolitical Alignment in FDI Flows
authors: Shekhar Aiyar, Davide Malacrino, Andrea Presbitero
official: 官方在线 2023-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Firms and policy makers are increasingly looking at friend-shoring to make supply chains less vulnerable to geopolitical tensions. We test whether these considerations are shaping FDI flows, using investment-level data on almost 300,000 instances of greenfield FDI between 2003 and 2022. Estimates from a gravity model, which controls for standard push and pull factors, show an economically significant role for geopolitical alignment in driving the geographical footprint of bilateral investments. This result is robust to the inclusion of standard bilateral drivers of FDI—such as geographic distance and trade flows—and the strength of the effect has increased since 2018, with the resurgence of trade tensions between the U.S. and China. Moreover, our results are not limited to greenfield FDI, but hold also for M&As.
abstract_zh: 企业和政策制定者日益关注"友岸外包"，以降低供应链受地缘政治紧张局势影响的风险。我们利用2003年至2022年间近30万例绿地外商直接投资的项目层面数据，检验这些考量是否正在影响外商直接投资的流动。基于引力模型的估计（该模型控制了标准的推拉因素）表明，地缘政治一致性在驱动双边投资的地理布局中发挥着具有经济显著性的作用。这一结果在纳入标准双边外商直接投资驱动因素（如地理距离和贸易流动）后依然稳健，且自2018年美中贸易紧张局势再度升级以来，该效应的强度有所增强。此外，我们的结论不仅适用于绿地外商直接投资，对并购活动同样成立。
